verdict.rationale: Navan documents breaking down spend by department, vendor, or category through its MCP server, and says Ava analyzes 'real-time spend data', so the core dimensions of the story are covered. However, the real-time claim appears only in an Ava blog post focused on travel and expense. Nothing shows same-day posting of card transactions or a founder-facing live spend view, and there is no independent corroboration. missing for 10: documented same-day/real-time transaction posting latency across all company spend, a native real-time spend dashboard by team/category/merchant (rather than AI-query access), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see company spend in real time — by team, category, and merchant — the day it happens, not when statements land

citations.quote: Analyze spend data — query expenses, identify trends, and break down costs by department, vendor, or category.
Ava slices and dices real-time spend data, provides insights into T&E questions, and proactively finds opportunities for savings.
The Navan MCP lets you connect Navan to your favorite AI products, so you can query Navan spend and travel data using natural language.
